purpose: Every version this skill has PASSed or BLOCKed, kept so a free daily Verified Ask call can catch an advisory that lands after the verdict. Paid escalation only for a PASS that a re-check contradicts.

rules.watch: PASS and BLOCK entries only. FLAG is an open question, not a decision, and is never watched.
rules.dailyCheck: Verified Ask only. Free. No paid call happens during the check itself.
rules.escalation: One fresh Telegraph ask, only for a PASS entry whose re-check comes back contradicted. One ask against /engine/ask first, the direct /engine/ask/20260828 only if the routed attempt was provably uncharged.
rules.blockEntries: Never escalated. A new advisory cannot un-block a blocked version; the widened advisory list is reported as a free finding.
